# AltSwitch

> A fast window switcher for Windows that replaces the built-in Alt+Tab. Search as you type, grouped by owning process, fully keyboard-driven, with live thumbnail previews. Summon it anywhere with Alt+4. Free for Windows 10 and 11.

## Pages
- [Home (中文)](https://shortcutplus.netlify.app/): Chinese landing page
- [Home (English)](https://shortcutplus.netlify.app/en/): English landing page

## Key facts
- Product: AltSwitch — a desktop replacement for the Windows Alt+Tab task switcher
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11 only
- Price: Free
- Global hotkey to summon: Alt + 4
- Keyboard model: type to filter, Up/Down to move across groups, Enter to switch, Esc to close

## Features
- Search-as-you-type filtering of window titles and process names
- Automatic grouping of windows by their owning process
- Keyboard-first navigation; no mouse required
- Live thumbnail preview of the selected window (via Electron desktopCapturer, matched by window handle)
- Synchronous, zero-lag window enumeration

## Technology
- Built with Electron 19, Vue 3, TypeScript and Vite
- Native Windows calls via koffi (a modern C FFI) — ships prebuilt binaries, no Python or Visual C++ toolchain required
- Enumerates windows with the Win32 EnumWindows API, filtering DWM-cloaked and tool windows
- Decodes GBK window titles on Chinese systems with iconv-lite
- Frameless, transparent, always-on-top overlay window
